Fonts in this folder were downloaded from Google Fonts (https://fonts.google.com) with scripts/fetch-fonts.js
and are served from this site so that visitors' IP addresses are not sent to Google.

Almost all families are licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/).
Roboto and Open Sans are licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).
The copyright notice of each family (its author/foundry) is shown on its page at https://fonts.google.com/specimen/<Family+Name>
and in the Google Fonts repository: https://github.com/google/fonts (folders ofl/ and apache/).

SIL OFL 1.1 in short: the fonts may be used, studied, modified and redistributed freely, including commercially, as long as
they are not sold on their own, the copyright notices and this licence stay with them, and modified versions do not use
the Reserved Font Name. The fonts are provided "as is", without warranty of any kind.
